review.agreeCheckbox: I have carefully read and agree to the contract terms above, understanding that this is a confirmation step before the system proceeds to payment and blockchain recording.

contract.contractGenerated: Contract generated from ERA Estate system, linked to transaction {id}
contract.contractIntro: Today, {date}, at ERA Estate Platform, we include:
contract.partyADetail: Detailed identification information such as ID card number, issue date, place of issue, permanent address are provided by the parties and stored separately, not fully displayed on this printout for security reasons.
contract.article1_3Note: Detailed information such as area, structure, legal status, land lot number, map sheet, land use right certificate number/apartment... are stored in the property file on the ERA Estate system.
contract.article2: Article 2. Contract Value and Payment Method
contract.article2_1: The estimated contract value is {amount} VND (in words: ..........................................................). This price serves as a basis for both parties to agree in detail in the notarized contract or contract appendix.
contract.article2_2: Party B pays Party A by method
contract.article2_3: The estimated actual amount Party A receives (after tax, service fee, platform fee) is {amount} VND. Taxes, fees and other costs are detailed in the transaction cost statistics section on the system.
contract.article2_4: Payment schedule (installments, deadlines, amount per installment, receiving account) will be agreed by both parties and stated in the contract appendix or official notarized contract.
contract.article3: Article 3. Basic Rights and Obligations of the Parties
contract.article3_1: Party A commits that the transaction property belongs to their lawful ownership/enjoyment, has no disputes, seizures, mortgages (except where both parties have other agreements) and meets transaction conditions according to legal regulations at the time of signing.
contract.article3_2: Party B commits to having fully researched information, current status of the property and agrees to buy/rent according to the contents published on the ERA Estate platform and according to agreements between the two parties.
contract.article3_3: Both parties have the obligation to coordinate in providing documents, performing notarization procedures, title transfer, registration of changes, property handover and payment on time as agreed.
contract.article3_4: Both parties are responsible for keeping transaction information confidential, except when required to provide by competent state agencies.
contract.article4_1: The time, location of property handover, property condition at the time of handover, accompanying equipment and furniture will be recorded in detail in a separate handover record between the two parties.
contract.article4_2: For rental contracts, the handover record must clearly show the property condition at the start and end of the rental period, as a basis for handling deposits and compensation responsibilities (if any).
contract.article5: Article 5. Taxes, Fees and Related Costs
contract.article5_1: Types of taxes and fees related to real estate transactions (personal income tax, registration fee, notarization fee, platform service fee, brokerage fee if any, etc.) will be agreed by both parties and stated in the notarized contract or contract appendix.
contract.article5_2: Tax and fee statistics information on the ERA Estate platform is for reference only and does not replace tax declaration, payment obligations and financial obligations according to legal regulations.
contract.article6: Article 6. Contract Violation Handling and Disputes
contract.article6_1: In case one party violates agreed obligations (late payment, late handover, unilateral cancellation of transaction without justifiable reason, etc.), both parties will prioritize negotiation to agree on handling solutions, including but not limited to violation penalties, damage compensation, continuation or termination of contract.
contract.article6_2: If negotiation is not possible, either party has the right to file a lawsuit at a competent court where the property is located or where the defendant resides according to Vietnamese law.
contract.article6_3: Transaction data and information recorded on blockchain (if any) are used as reference evidence about the transaction process between the two parties.
contract.article7_1: This contract is made in electronic form on the ERA Estate platform, expressing the voluntary will of the parties when performing transaction confirmation, payment and signing on blockchain.
contract.article7_2: This electronic contract has reference value and supports information transparency, does not replace notarized contracts or other official legal documents signed by the parties outside the system.
contract.article7_3: Both parties commit to having read and understood the entire contract content, were not deceived or coerced when participating in the transaction and agree to be legally responsible for all information provided.
contract.article3_5: Party A has the right to require Party B to pay on time and in full as agreed.
contract.article3_6: Party B has the right to require Party A to hand over the property on time, in the condition as agreed.
contract.article3_7: In case the property has defects or is not as described, Party B has the right to require Party A to remedy or adjust the transaction value.
contract.article3_8: Both parties have the right to require the other party to provide all documents related to the property and transaction.
contract.article4_3: Party A is obliged to hand over the property in clean condition, with no other person using it (unless otherwise agreed), and with no illegal obstacles.
contract.article4_4: Party B is obliged to receive the property on the agreed deadline. If Party B delays receipt without justifiable reason, Party A has the right to claim damages.
contract.article5_3: Party A is responsible for paying taxes and fees related to ownership and land use rights before the transaction date.
contract.article5_4: Party B is responsible for paying taxes and fees related to transfer, name change, and registration of changes after receiving the property.
contract.article6_4: Specific violation penalty: If Party B delays payment for more than 15 days from the agreed deadline, Party B must pay a penalty of 0.05% of the contract value for each day of delay.
contract.article6_5: If Party A delays property handover for more than 15 days from the agreed deadline, Party A must pay a penalty of 0.05% of the contract value for each day of delay.
contract.article6_6: In case one party unilaterally cancels the contract without justifiable reason, the violating party must compensate the other party an amount equivalent to 10% of the contract value.
contract.article8_1: This contract takes effect from the date both parties sign and confirm on the ERA Estate system.
contract.article8_2: Contract performance period: Both parties agree to complete payment and property handover within 90 days from the contract signing date, unless otherwise agreed.
contract.article8_3: This contract will terminate when: (a) Both parties have completed all obligations under the contract; (b) Both parties agree to terminate the contract in writing; (c) One party unilaterally cancels the contract as specified in Article 6.
contract.article9_1: Any contract adjustment or amendment must be agreed upon by both parties in writing and signed for confirmation.
contract.article9_2: Contract adjustments and amendments must not change the nature of the original transaction and must comply with legal regulations.
contract.article9_3: In case of transaction value adjustment, both parties must update the information on the ERA Estate system and (if any) record on blockchain.
contract.article10_1: For purchase contracts: Party A commits to warranty defects in structure, electrical, water, and sanitation systems of the property within 12 months from the handover date, except for damages caused by Party B's improper use.
contract.article10_2: For rental contracts: Party A is obliged to maintain and repair damages not caused by Party B's fault. Party B is obliged to preserve and use the property for the correct purpose and promptly report damages to Party A.
contract.article10_3: Maintenance and repair costs during the rental period will be agreed upon by both parties, except for damages caused by Party B's fault, which Party B must bear all costs.
contract.article11_1: In case of force majeure events (natural disasters, fires, wars, epidemics, decisions by competent state agencies...) that prevent one party from performing obligations, that party is not liable for damages.
contract.article11_2: The party encountering force majeure must immediately notify the other party in writing within 7 days from the occurrence of the event and provide evidence.
contract.article11_3: Both parties will negotiate to extend the contract performance period or terminate the contract depending on the impact level of the force majeure event.
contract.article12_1: All notices and requests between the two parties must be sent in writing to the email address registered on the ERA Estate system or the permanent address provided.
contract.article12_2: Notices are considered received after 3 days from the sending date (if sent by post) or immediately after sending (if sent by email, electronic message).
contract.article12_3: In case of change of contact address, the changing party must notify the other party in writing at least 7 days before the change takes effect.
contract.article13: Article 13. Applicable Law and Dispute Resolution
contract.article13_1: This contract is governed by the laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
contract.article13_2: All disputes arising from or related to this contract, first both parties will negotiate to resolve within 30 days from the date of dispute.
contract.article13_3: If no agreement is reached through negotiation, both parties may agree to bring the case to an Arbitration Center or file a lawsuit at a competent People's Court according to legal regulations.
contract.article13_4: The competent court to resolve disputes is the People's Court where the property is located or where the defendant resides.
contract.article14_1: This contract is recorded on the ERA Estate blockchain system to increase transparency and security of transaction information.
contract.article14_2: Transaction information encrypted and stored on blockchain includes: transaction code, contract value, signing time, blockchain wallet addresses of the parties (if any).
contract.article14_3: Data on blockchain has value as reference evidence in case of disputes, but does not replace official legal documents.
contract.article14_4: Both parties commit to keeping blockchain access information confidential and not disclosing to third parties without the other party's consent or request from competent state agencies.
contract.article15_1: This contract is made in 02 (two) copies with equal legal value, each party keeps 01 (one) copy. In addition, one copy is stored on the ERA Estate system and (if any) on blockchain.
contract.article15_2: This contract may be printed on paper or stored in electronic form. Printed and electronic copies have equal legal value.
contract.article15_3: In case of differences between terms in this contract, priority applies in order: (1) Terms amended and supplemented later; (2) Specific terms; (3) General terms.
contract.article15_4: Both parties confirm having read carefully, understood and agreed to the entire content of this contract. The contract takes effect from the time both parties sign and confirm on the ERA Estate system and (if any) on blockchain.
contract.contractFooter: This contract is automatically generated from the ERA Estate system based on transaction data and (if any) information recorded on blockchain. To complete real estate purchase/rental, both parties still need to sign a notarized contract or official legal document according to legal regulations.
contract.contractFooterWarning: To print/save the official contract, please sign the blockchain contract with MetaMask in the right panel. After the on-chain transaction is confirmed, the Print/Save PDF button will be activated.
contract.blockchainInfoDesc: This transaction has been recorded on blockchain with transaction code and detailed information securely stored on the distributed system.
contract.article2_7: Payment installment 1 (deposit): 20% of contract value within 7 days from contract signing date.
contract.article2_8: Payment installment 2: 30% of contract value upon completion of notarization and title transfer procedures.
contract.article2_9: Payment installment 3: 40% of contract value upon receiving property handover.
contract.article2_10: Final payment installment: 10% of contract value after completing change registration and receiving new ownership certificate.
contract.article2_11: Each payment installment must be made on time. In case of late payment, the violating party must pay late interest as regulated.
contract.article2_12: Party A's receiving account will be separately notified and recorded in the contract appendix.
contract.article3_9: Party A is obliged to provide fully and accurately all legal documents related to the property including: Land use right certificate/ownership certificate, location diagram, planning documents, tax and fee payment documents.
contract.article3_10: Party B is obliged to provide full personal identification documents and documents proving financial capacity to execute the transaction.
contract.article3_11: Party A commits not to have any commitments or agreements with third parties related to the property that Party B is not aware of and has not agreed to.
contract.article3_12: Party B commits to use the property for the correct purpose, not to use it for illegal activities affecting security and order.
contract.article4_5: Property handover must be conducted at the property location, with witnesses from both parties or authorized representatives.
contract.article4_6: The handover record must clearly state: (a) Date and time of handover; (b) Current condition of the property; (c) List of assets and equipment included; (d) Damages and defects (if any); (e) Confirmation signatures of both parties.
contract.article4_7: After handover, Party B is responsible for preserving and maintaining the property. All damages arising from Party B's fault will be repaired and compensated by Party B.
contract.article4_8: For purchase contracts, Party A must hand over all keys, access cards, access codes and documents related to property management and use.
contract.article5_5: Personal income tax from real estate transfer: Applied according to current legal regulations on tax. Party A is responsible for declaration and payment, unless otherwise agreed.
contract.article5_6: Registration fee (if any): Party B is responsible for payment when performing title transfer and change registration procedures.
contract.article5_7: Contract notarization fee: Agreed by both parties, usually each party bears 50% or as separately agreed.
contract.article5_8: ERA Estate platform service fee: Calculated according to platform regulations, borne by the service user.
contract.article5_9: Other fees such as change registration fee, surveying fee, document re-issuance fee (if any) will be agreed by both parties or according to legal regulations.
contract.article6_7: If Party B fails to pay on time for more than 30 days without justifiable reason, Party A has the right to unilaterally terminate the contract and retain all received amounts, while requesting Party B to compensate for damages.
contract.article6_8: If Party A fails to hand over the property on time for more than 30 days without justifiable reason, Party B has the right to unilaterally terminate the contract and request Party A to refund all paid amounts plus interest and compensation for damages.
contract.article6_9: All damages arising from contract violations will be calculated based on actual value and agreed by both parties or decided by the Court.
contract.article7_4: This contract is stored on the ERA Estate electronic system with full security features and information encryption.
contract.article7_5: Both parties have the right to access, view, and download the electronic contract at any time through their ERA Estate system account.
contract.article16: Article 16. Legal Documents and Ownership Rights
contract.article16_1: Party A commits that the property has full valid legal documents issued by competent state agencies, not forged, erased, or illegally modified.
contract.article16_2: The land use right certificate/ownership certificate for houses and assets attached to land must still be valid, not revoked, cancelled or under dispute resolution.
contract.article16_3: Party A is obliged to provide notarized copies of all related legal documents to Party B within 7 days from the contract signing date.
contract.article16_4: In case legal documents are found invalid, incomplete or problematic, Party B has the right to request Party A to remedy or cancel the contract and request compensation.
contract.article16_5: The ownership rights and land use rights of the property must be fully transferred to Party B after completing title transfer and change registration procedures.
contract.article17_1: Party A commits that the property is not subject to land recovery, clearance, or relocation planning by the State for at least 5 years from the contract signing date.
contract.article17_2: If the property is subject to planning, Party A must clearly notify Party B before signing the contract. Party B has the right to decide to continue or cancel the transaction.
contract.article17_3: Party A commits that the property is built according to planning, has valid construction permit (if required), and does not violate construction regulations.
contract.article17_4: All works and constructions violating planning or without permits will be handled and remedied by Party A before handover.
contract.article18_1: Party A commits that the property is provided with full basic utilities: electricity, water, drainage system, internet, cable TV (if any).
contract.article18_2: Debts for electricity, water, and service fees arising before the handover date will be paid by Party A. Amounts arising after the handover date will be borne by Party B.
contract.article18_3: Party A is obliged to hand over service contracts (electricity, water, internet...) and assist Party B in performing procedures to change the user name (if needed).
contract.article18_4: Public utilities such as roads, lighting systems, green spaces, playgrounds... (if any) must be maintained according to management agency regulations.
contract.article19_1: Risks of loss or damage to the property will be transferred from Party A to Party B from the actual handover time.
contract.article19_2: Both parties are encouraged to purchase property insurance. The purchase of insurance and insurance costs will be agreed by both parties.
contract.article19_3: In case the property is damaged due to force majeure before handover, both parties will negotiate to adjust the contract value or cancel the contract.
contract.article19_4: Party B is responsible for purchasing civil liability insurance (if needed) and other types of insurance as required by law after receiving handover.
contract.article20_1: Party A commits to hand over the property without any person illegally residing or using it, unless otherwise agreed between the parties.
contract.article20_2: Party A is obliged to completely resolve issues related to third parties using or occupying the property before handing over to Party B.
contract.article20_3: After receiving handover, Party B is responsible for ensuring security and safety of the property, implementing fire prevention, explosion prevention, and theft prevention measures as regulated.
contract.article20_4: Party B has the right to change locks, access codes, and install security and surveillance systems after receiving handover.
contract.article21_1: Party A commits to hand over the property in sanitary condition, without toxic waste or environmental pollution.
contract.article21_2: Party B is responsible for maintaining environmental sanitation around the property, complying with local environmental protection regulations.
contract.article21_3: All environmental violations arising after handover will be borne by Party B. Violations arising before handover will be borne by Party A.
contract.article22: Article 22. Rights and Obligations of Third Parties
contract.article22_1: Party A commits not to have any commitments or obligations with third parties related to the property that may affect Party B's rights, unless Party B is aware and agrees.
contract.article22_2: In case a third party files complaints or disputes regarding rights to the property, Party A is obliged to resolve and protect Party B's rights.
contract.article22_3: Party B has the right to refuse handover if discovering third parties disputing or complaining about rights to the property that Party A has not resolved.
contract.article23_1: Party B may pay in cash or bank transfer. All payments must have valid documents and invoices.
contract.article23_2: In case of bank transfer payment, Party B must clearly state the transfer content as regulated and notify Party A immediately after execution.
contract.article23_3: Party A has the right to request Party B to provide documents proving the legal origin of the payment amount if there are suspicions.
contract.article23_4: Both parties may agree to use escrow services of banks or credit institutions to ensure transaction safety.
contract.article24_1: Both parties are obliged to coordinate in fully and timely performing procedures: contract notarization, title transfer, change registration, certificate re-issuance (if needed).
contract.article24_2: Costs for administrative and legal procedures will be agreed by both parties or according to legal regulations. Usually, each party is responsible for procedures related to themselves.
contract.article24_3: Procedure execution time: Contract notarization within 15 days, title transfer and change registration within 30 days from contract signing date (except in case of force majeure).
contract.article24_4: Party A is obliged to provide full documents and papers necessary for state agencies to perform procedures. Party B is obliged to coordinate and provide information when requested.
contract.article25_1: This contract is made in Vietnamese. In case of translation into other languages, the Vietnamese version will have the highest legal value.
contract.article25_2: All agreements and commitments between the two parties related to this transaction must be expressed in writing and recorded in the contract or contract appendix.
contract.article25_3: The terms in this contract are independent of each other. The invalidity of one term does not affect the validity of other terms.
contract.article25_4: Both parties commit to properly and fully perform obligations under the contract. Any changes or additions must be agreed by both parties in writing.
contract.article25_5: This contract takes effect from the date both parties sign and confirm and will terminate when both parties have completed all obligations or as regulated in other contract terms.

walletGuide.title: Prepare MetaMask & network
walletGuide.subtitle: Minimum steps before signing on-chain real estate transactions on ERA Estate
walletGuide.step1Body: MetaMask is a browser wallet used to sign smart-contract transactions. Install the extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) or the mobile app.
walletGuide.step1Item1: Download only from metamask.io — avoid unofficial links.
walletGuide.step1Item2: Create a new wallet or restore with your secret phrase; never share your phrase.
walletGuide.step2Body: The app and contract only work when MetaMask uses the configured network (e.g. local Hardhat, Sepolia, or the network specified by the project).
walletGuide.networkHint: If MetaMask shows the wrong network, add the network manually or use “Connect wallet” from the transaction page when supported.
walletGuide.step3Body: Each contract call spends a small network fee. On testnets, use a faucet for free tokens. On mainnet, keep enough balance for gas.
walletGuide.step4Body: The address below comes from VITE_REALESTATE_CONTRACT_ADDRESS. It must match the contract deployed on the network you use.
walletGuide.legalBody: On-chain records do not replace notarized contracts. See the legal and security centers for what data is stored on-chain.
